card.name: Injury and effect as cause terms
card.fires_on: The words "injury" or "effect" when listed as a cause or mechanism of a condition, and "on" in "drugs that act (directly) on the renin-angiotensin system".

modes.label: Injury as a cause
modes.description: The word injury (or toxic effect) appears in a list of causes of a condition.
modes.example: There are many causes of pericarditis, including infections,<< injury>>, radiation treatment, and chronic diseases.

modes.label: Act on the renin-angiotensin system
modes.description: The word "on" after "drugs that act (directly)" in fetal toxicity warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: FETAL TOXICITY When pregnancy is detected, discontinue Lotensin HCT as soon as possible. Drugs that act directly<< on>> the renin-angiotensin
